variables.name: Air temperature
variables.description: Near-surface or reported air temperature in Celsius.

variables.name: Precipitation
variables.description: Liquid-equivalent precipitation amount over the stated interval.

variables.name: Mean sea-level pressure
variables.description: Atmospheric pressure reduced to mean sea level.

variables.name: Wind direction
variables.description: Meteorological wind direction (from which the wind blows).

variables.name: Significant wave height
variables.description: NDBC significant wave height when reported.

variables.name: Water temperature
variables.description: Sea surface or bulk water temperature from buoy sensors.

variables.name: Reference evapotranspiration (FAO-56)
variables.description: Daily ET0 from Open-Meteo daily climate block.

variables.name: Temperature z-score
variables.description: (T - baseline_mean) / baseline_std over the rolling window.

variables.name: Station count
variables.description: Number of stations in a discovery index (IGRA, NDBC, GHCN).
